svg.aria-label: Fig. 7 Beyond the core, cache hierarchy and memory
svg.text: Fig. 7 Beyond the core, cache hierarchy and memory
The P-cluster shares an L2 and an AMX unit. The SLC sits on the memory side of coherence and fills from L2 victims.
4 Firestorm cores, 3.2 GHz max, one clock domain
12 MiB, 12 ways, 128 B lines (two 64 B halves), 8192 sets
17 cycles hit, 85 GB/s load and 100 GB/s store per core
inclusive of L1D; replacement spares L1-resident lines (AutoLock)
behaves as four 3 MiB per-core slices; one core sees ~7.5 MiB
L1 to L2 path 32 B/cycle each direction per core; L2 TLB and page walkers may sit beside the L2 (patent)
The E cores may use this L2 while the P cores sleep (patent)
4 cores, own L2, own clock domain
per-cluster DVFS, ramp from idle 40 to 100 ms
power estimator throttles vector and AMX issue
coherence point with duplicate L2 tags, before the SLC
separate PIO network for device traffic
memory side, exclusive of the CPU caches
hashed set index from PA bits 7 up
68.25 GB/s peak, 64 GB/s from one core
one core saturates DRAM; mixed R/W shares one path
E-cluster and GPU also request through the fabric
Latency ladder from one core, cycles at 3.2 GHz
